CQ01.query: MATCH (a:Asset)-[:HAS_SENSOR]->(s:Sensor {name:'VT-101'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PART_OF]->(a) RETURN a.name, s.description, s.unit, collect(c.name) AS parts;

CQ02.query: MATCH (r:Asset {name:'R-101'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:INSTALLED_IN|PART_OF]->(r) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:HAS_SENSOR]->(s) RETURN collect(DISTINCT x.name) AS members, collect(DISTINCT s.name) AS sensors;

CQ03.query: MATCH (:Asset {name:'M-101'})-[:HAS_PROCEDURE]->(d:Document) RETURN d.name, d.version ORDER BY d.version DESC;

CQ04.query: SELECT e.payload->>'tag', e.payload->>'value', e.payload->>'ts', e.payload->>'quality' FROM manufacturing_events e WHERE kind='alarm_received' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3;

CQ05.query: SELECT p.id, jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p.body->'cause_assessment','[]')) AS candidates, p.body->'citations', p.evidence->'graph'->'documents'->0->>'version' FROM manufacturing_proposals p WHERE NOT (p.body ? 'cause_assessment') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3;
CQ05.need: 구조화된 원인후보 + 관측 근거 + 문서 버전(요약문에만 있으면 partial)

CQ06.query: SELECT p.id, (p.evidence ? 'history') AS observed, (p.body ? 'summary') AS inferred FROM manufacturing_proposals p WHERE NOT (p.body ? 'cause_assessment') LIMIT 3;

CQ07.query: SELECT r.model, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT e.payload->>'tool', ',') FROM manufacturing_events e WHERE e.payload->>'run_id'=r.id::text AND e.kind='agent_tool_started') AS tools, NULL AS prompt_version FROM manufacturing_analysis_runs r ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3;

CQ08.query: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='manufacturing_proposals' AND column_name IN ('decision','completed_at','decided_by');

CQ09.query: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='manufacturing_proposals' AND column_name IN ('state_fingerprint','result','started_at');
CQ09.need: 승인 시점 조건 지문과 실행 직전 재검사 결과 칸(capability)

CQ10.query: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name IN ('manufacturing_proposals','manufacturing_operator_commands') AND column_name='result';
CQ10.need: 명령 응답과 상태 반영 확인 결과 칸(capability)

CQ11.query: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name IN ('manufacturing_operator_commands','manufacturing_proposals') AND column_name IN ('blocked_by','path');
CQ11.need: 인터록 차단 기록 + 경로 C1/C2/C3 구분 칸(capability)

CQ12.query: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p.body->'citations','[]'))=0) AS without_docs, count(*) AS total FROM manufacturing_proposals p WHERE NOT (p.body ? 'cause_assessment');
CQ12.need: 근거 문서 없는 원인후보 수를 셀 수 있음

CQ13.query: SELECT device, correlation_key, count(*) FROM manufacturing_incidents GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 3;

CQ14.query: MATCH (i) WHERE i:Interlock OR (i:ControlPoint AND i.name='interlock') OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[r]-(x) RETURN labels(i), i.name, type(r), x.name;
CQ14.need: 인터록 → 막는 명령 관계(문서 절 검색으로만 찾으면 partial)

CQ15.query: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name LIKE 'manufacturing%' AND column_name IN ('ack_state','acknowledged_by','acknowledged_at','shelved');
